decisions.reason: Builds directly on the firm's existing secure communication and encryption capabilities, so learning and improvement are likely.
Closely related to the firm's digital signature and mobile identity knowledge and its push toward online contract signing.
The end-to-end security architecture extends existing identity and communication security know-how, supporting absorptive capacity.
Although more peripheral, secure email-to-app delivery still draws on the firm's secure communication and app protection expertise.
The hardware signature token builds on the firm's hardware options and cryptography knowledge, enabling it to evaluate and refine the product.
The payment network compliance suite requires specific payment-industry domain knowledge that is less related to the firm's existing identity and security capabilities.
